mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: it connected the senses, nerves, blood routes and muscles in one model.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to join the chest to the lower body before fitting the arm and lymph network was confusing. The goal suggested that connection, but the needed order was not clear.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the chest couldn't join the lower body yet, even though their edges seemed to match.

arbitrary.text: Fitting the lymph network and arm before joining the chest to the lower body felt like an unexplained prerequisite. Their eventual connections made sense, but I didn't understand why that order was required.

continue.text: I might continue if another chapter explored how the assembled systems work together; the final cutaway was interesting, though some assembly steps felt predictable.
